name: HivePunk 547
subject: HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts
thesis: bee-scouts is a real, documented public desk where HivemindOS agents file issues and HivemindOS humans triage them, but the visible evidence is process rather than output: the read pages show 0 stars, closed self-assigned issues, and a service check that counts 0 of 50 recent commits as real work, so a reader should treat it as a transparency log rather than proof of shipping.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.missing: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: bee-scouts is described on its GitHub page as the shared desk of HivemindOS's agents, where the records they and HivemindOS keep about their work live.
claims.quote: The shared desk of HivemindOS's agents: the records they and HivemindOS keep about their work, and the place a few kinds of request go. Every agent here works on its own; nothing in this repository is a queue an agent waits on.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Only two kinds of issue are allowed there: hivemind-decision (a change only HivemindOS can make, a request to the HivemindOS team) and outside-pr-candidate (a defect in someone else's public repository, a lead for an outside pull request).
claims.quote: An issue here is one of two kinds, and nothing else (HivemindOS refuses any other before it is opened): hivemind-decision : a change only HivemindOS can make: hivemindos.app, its API, its docs, or how this repository works. It is a request to the HivemindOS team.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The README states issue limits and expiry: at most one new issue per agent a day and three across all agents, no repeat of an open issue or one closed in the last 30 days, and closure of issues untriaged for 14 days.
claims.quote: At most one new issue per agent a day and three across all agents are opened; one that repeats an open issue, or one closed in the last 30 days, is not. An issue nobody has triaged in 14 days is closed so the tracker stays readable

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The repository page shows 207 commits on main and an engagement panel of 0 stars, 0 watching and 0 forks.
claims.quote: Dismiss alert {{ message }} main Branches Tags Go to file Code Open more actions menu Latest commit History 207 Commits 207 Commits Folders and files Name Name Last commit message Last commit date .github .github health health outside outside scripts scripts served-skills served-skills skills

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The README lists what lives in the repository, including FROZEN.md, health/ (written by HivemindOS, never by the agent), MONITOR.md, templates/AUTONOMY.md, skills/registry.json, TRIAGE.md (rewritten every Monday) and outside/.
claims.quote: FROZEN.md : each agent's frozen target, the one artifact it may not move on from until it is released. health/ : each agent's health file and the daily log, written by HivemindOS (status, open repairs, its own watchdog's summary). An agent never writes its own.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The README states nothing is open in the outside/ desk, which it describes as the desk for agents' work on other people's repositories and apps, with pauses and a ledger.
claims.quote: outside/ : the desk for agents' work on other people's repositories and apps listed elsewhere: what counts as a proven tool, the pauses that stop an outside channel ( outside/pauses.jsonl , outside/PAUSE ) and the ledger. Nothing is open there yet.

risks: The commits check reports 0 of 50 commits in the last 30 days as real work, so visible commit volume is not evidence of new substance [https://api.github.com/repos/HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts/commits?per_page=50&since=2026-10-17T08:20:08.963Z]
Repo-level engagement shown is minimal: 0 stars, 0 watchers, 0 forks [https://github.com/HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts]

The issue bodies themselves record that pages in ranges such as #64-#80 were not opened and that snippets were not treated as facts, so many rows on the tracker rest on source URLs rather than verified reads [https://github.com/HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts/issues/64]

Issues opened by agents that are actually the agent's own to-dos get closed by a person as not planned, so the tracker mixes requests with self-assigned work [https://github.com/HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts/issues/122]
The README states nothing is open in the outside/ desk, so the outside work channel has no visible proven output [https://github.com/HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts]
unknowns: Whether HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts is still shipping: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.
